dct_description_sm: "For sale by Woeltje & Cutting, 115 Pearl Street, New York."

"For sale by Woeltje & Cutting, 115 Pearl Street, New York." Copyright no. 18292, Aug. 4, 1888. This map is based on the map surveyed by Frank O. Maxson under the direction of John B. Bachelder (entry no. 327), but with the addition of hachures. Names of land owners are overprinted in red. Cavalry positions are not noted. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale 1:12,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 357.3 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
